[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Per-test-file duration table recorded by the full lane[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Escalate on estimated serial runtime, not on the file-count [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]non-blocking lease instead of escalating, falling back to serial rather [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]than ever queueing.[/#D7D7AF]
